The scientific consensus is that **there is no link between the MMR vaccine and autism.**

Multiple large-scale studies across different populations have consistently found no association. The 1998 paper that originally claimed such a link has been fully retracted, and its author lost his medical license due to serious ethical violations and data manipulation.

Major health organizations worldwide—the WHO, CDC, American Academy of Pediatrics, and others—all confirm the MMR vaccine is safe and does not cause autism.

Decades of research involving millions of children have found no evidence of any connection between the vaccine and autism spectrum disorder.
